::: {#hero-heading}
I am a biostatistician and an R developer.<br> I lead the data analytics team at [Perisphere Real World Evidence](https://www.perisphere-rwe.com/),<br> where we build open-source R tools that turn real-world data<br> into publication-ready evidence. I also develop software for<br> oblique random forests and study blood pressure and cardiovascular health.
